_comment: Raspberry Pi 5 gateway. Terminates node traffic, forwards upstream, scores locally.
_queue_note: 200000 frames x 300 B = 60 MB. At 50 nodes hourly that is 166 days of outage cover; see tools/holdover.py.

scorer._kind_note: cpu_features is the only kind that works: 17 us/frame measured. 'hailo' raises -- there is no trained waveform model to compile. See gateway/hailo_backend.py.

channels.name: gateway_self
channels._note: A gateway has no sensor of its own. This channel exists only so --self-test exercises the full path; delete it on a pure aggregation deployment.
